statements:
CREATE TABLE nf_objects (
	hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_objects PRIMARY KEY (hash), 
	CONSTRAINT object_nonnegative CHECK (size >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_works (
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	canon_branch_id UUID, 
	canon_epoch BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	policy_version TEXT NOT NULL, 
	policy_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	rules_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	interpretation_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	interpretation_epoch BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_works PRIMARY KEY (work_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_task_commands (
	principal_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	command_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	receipt JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_task_commands PRIMARY KEY (principal_id, idempotency_key)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_task_fairness (
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	task_kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	last_served_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' NOT NULL, 
	claims BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_task_fairness PRIMARY KEY (work_id, task_kind)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_budgets (
	budget_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	limit_amount NUMERIC(20, 6) NOT NULL, 
	reserved_amount NUMERIC(20, 6) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	spent_amount NUMERIC(20, 6) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_budgets PRIMARY KEY (budget_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_budget_balance CHECK (limit_amount >= 0 AND reserved_amount >= 0 AND spent_amount >= 0 AND reserved_amount + spent_amount <= limit_amount), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_budget_currency CHECK (currency IN ('USD','CNY'))
)

CREATE TABLE nf_outbox (
	outbox_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	topic TEXT NOT NULL, 
	aggregate_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	aggregate_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	dedupe_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	lease_owner TEXT, 
	lease_expiry TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL, 
	delivered_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_outbox PRIMARY KEY (outbox_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_outbox_state CHECK (state IN ('PENDING','DELIVERING','DELIVERED')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nf_outbox_dedupe_key UNIQUE (dedupe_key)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_outbox_pending ON nf_outbox (state, created_at)

CREATE TABLE nf_inbox (
	consumer TEXT NOT NULL, 
	message_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	processed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_inbox PRIMARY KEY (consumer, message_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_object_refs (
	owner_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	object_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_object_refs PRIMARY KEY (owner_type, owner_id, object_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_object_refs_object_hash_nf_objects FOREIGN KEY(object_hash) REFERENCES nf_objects (hash)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_genesis (
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_genesis PRIMARY KEY (work_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_genesis_work_id_nf_works FOREIGN KEY(work_id) REFERENCES nf_works (work_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_branches (
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	head_revision_id UUID, 
	fork_ref JSONB, 
	history_epoch BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	repair_ready BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_branches PRIMARY KEY (branch_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_branches_work_id_nf_works FOREIGN KEY(work_id) REFERENCES nf_works (work_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nf_branches_work_id UNIQUE (work_id, branch_id), 
	CONSTRAINT branch_kind CHECK (kind IN ('CANON','CANDIDATE','SIMULATION','REPAIR'))
)

CREATE TABLE nf_events (
	event_version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	occurrence_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	effect_group_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	representation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	object_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_events PRIMARY KEY (event_version_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_events_work_id_nf_works FOREIGN KEY(work_id) REFERENCES nf_works (work_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_events_object_hash_nf_objects FOREIGN KEY(object_hash) REFERENCES nf_objects (hash), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nf_events_work_id UNIQUE (work_id, event_version_id, occurrence_id, effect_group_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_grants (
	grant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	principal_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	role_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	actor_id UUID, 
	branch_ids JSONB NOT NULL, 
	capabilities JSONB NOT NULL, 
	planes JSONB NOT NULL, 
	max_story_time JSONB NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'true' NOT NULL, 
	epoch BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_grants PRIMARY KEY (grant_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_grants_work_id_nf_works FOREIGN KEY(work_id) REFERENCES nf_works (work_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nf_grants_token_hash UNIQUE (token_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_artifacts (
	artifact_revision_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB, 
	created_by UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_artifacts PRIMARY KEY (artifact_revision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_artifacts_sha256_nf_objects FOREIGN KEY(sha256) REFERENCES nf_objects (hash), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_artifacts_work_id_nf_works FOREIGN KEY(work_id) REFERENCES nf_works (work_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nf_artifacts_work_id UNIQUE (work_id, artifact_revision_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_selections (
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	selection_kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	artifact_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	epoch BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_selections PRIMARY KEY (work_id, selection_kind), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_selections_work_id_nf_works FOREIGN KEY(work_id) REFERENCES nf_works (work_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_promotions (
	promotion_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	old_world_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	new_world_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	report_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_promotions PRIMARY KEY (promotion_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_promotions_work_id_nf_works FOREIGN KEY(work_id) REFERENCES nf_works (work_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_revisions (
	world_revision_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_seq BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	parent_revision_id UUID, 
	selection JSONB NOT NULL, 
	frontiers JSONB NOT NULL, 
	scope_versions JSONB NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	interpretation_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	manifest_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	provenance JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_revisions PRIMARY KEY (world_revision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_revisions_work_id_nf_branches FOREIGN KEY(work_id, branch_id) REFERENCES nf_branches (work_id, branch_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nf_revisions_branch_id UNIQUE (branch_id, branch_seq), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nf_revisions_work_id UNIQUE (work_id, branch_id, world_revision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_revisions_work_id_nf_revisions FOREIGN KEY(work_id, branch_id, parent_revision_id) REFERENCES nf_revisions (work_id, branch_id, world_revision_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT revision_seq CHECK (branch_seq >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_contexts (
	context_bundle_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	task_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	principal_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	grant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	dependency_manifest JSONB NOT NULL, 
	artifact_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	read_cut JSONB NOT NULL, 
	dependency_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_contexts PRIMARY KEY (context_bundle_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_contexts_work_id_nf_works FOREIGN KEY(work_id) REFERENCES nf_works (work_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_contexts_grant_id_nf_grants FOREIGN KEY(grant_id) REFERENCES nf_grants (grant_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nf_contexts_task_id UNIQUE (task_id, generation)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_scopes (
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	scope_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	tombstone BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_scopes PRIMARY KEY (work_id, branch_id, scope_key), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_scopes_work_id_nf_branches FOREIGN KEY(work_id, branch_id) REFERENCES nf_branches (work_id, branch_id), 
	CONSTRAINT scope_monotonic_nonnegative CHECK (version >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_receipts (
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	principal_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	command_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	proposal_id UUID, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_receipts PRIMARY KEY (work_id, principal_id, command_type, idempotency_key), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_receipts_work_id_nf_branches FOREIGN KEY(work_id, branch_id) REFERENCES nf_branches (work_id, branch_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nf_receipts_branch_id UNIQUE (branch_id, proposal_id, command_type)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_dependencies (
	dependency_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	owner_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	scope_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	observed_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	dependency_kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_dependencies PRIMARY KEY (dependency_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_dependencies_work_id_nf_branches FOREIGN KEY(work_id, branch_id) REFERENCES nf_branches (work_id, branch_id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_dependencies_scope ON nf_dependencies (work_id, branch_id, scope_key)

CREATE TABLE nf_index_watermarks (
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	index_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	world_revision_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_seq BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_index_watermarks PRIMARY KEY (branch_id, index_name), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_index_watermarks_branch_id_nf_branches FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES nf_branches (branch_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_tasks (
	task_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	principal_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	grant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	task_kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	role_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	context_bundle_id UUID, 
	dependency_fingerprint VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_owner TEXT, 
	lease_expiry TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	deadline TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	current_result_id UUID, 
	attempt_id UUID, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_tasks PRIMARY KEY (task_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_tasks_work_id_nf_branches FOREIGN KEY(work_id, branch_id) REFERENCES nf_branches (work_id, branch_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_tasks_grant_id_nf_grants FOREIGN KEY(grant_id) REFERENCES nf_grants (grant_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_task_generation CHECK (generation >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_task_state CHECK (state IN ('BLOCKED','READY','RUNNING','RESULT_STORED','VALIDATING','WAITING_REVIEW','ACCEPTED','STALE','PAUSED','CANCELLED','FAILED')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_running_lease CHECK (state != 'RUNNING' OR (lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expiry IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_task_bound_context CHECK (state NOT IN ('RESULT_STORED','VALIDATING','WAITING_REVIEW','ACCEPTED') OR (context_bundle_id IS NOT NULL AND dependency_fingerprint IS NOT NULL))
)
CREATE INDEX ix_tasks_ready ON nf_tasks (state, work_id, task_kind, created_at)

CREATE TABLE nf_revision_events (
	world_revision_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	occurrence_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	event_version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	effect_group_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_revision_events PRIMARY KEY (world_revision_id, occurrence_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_revision_events_work_id_nf_revisions FOREIGN KEY(work_id, branch_id, world_revision_id) REFERENCES nf_revisions (work_id, branch_id, world_revision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_revision_events_work_id_nf_events FOREIGN KEY(work_id, event_version_id, occurrence_id, effect_group_id) REFERENCES nf_events (work_id, event_version_id, occurrence_id, effect_group_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nf_revision_events_world_revision_id UNIQUE (world_revision_id, effect_group_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_commits (
	world_revision_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	operations JSONB NOT NULL, 
	request JSONB NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_commits PRIMARY KEY (world_revision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_commits_world_revision_id_nf_revisions FOREIGN KEY(world_revision_id) REFERENCES nf_revisions (world_revision_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_proposals (
	proposal_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	principal_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	task_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	context_bundle_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	artifact_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	template_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	template_args JSONB NOT NULL, 
	footprint JSONB NOT NULL, 
	closure JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_proposals PRIMARY KEY (proposal_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_proposals_context_bundle_id_nf_contexts FOREIGN KEY(context_bundle_id) REFERENCES nf_contexts (context_bundle_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_proposals_work_id_nf_branches FOREIGN KEY(work_id, branch_id) REFERENCES nf_branches (work_id, branch_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_invalidations (
	invalidation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	world_revision_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	scope_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_invalidations PRIMARY KEY (invalidation_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_invalidations_world_revision_id_nf_revisions FOREIGN KEY(world_revision_id) REFERENCES nf_revisions (world_revision_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_task_inputs (
	task_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	spec JSONB NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_task_inputs PRIMARY KEY (task_id, generation), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_task_inputs_task_id_nf_tasks FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES nf_tasks (task_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_task_results (
	result_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	task_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	disposition VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_task_results PRIMARY KEY (result_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_result_disposition CHECK (disposition IN ('CURRENT','LATE','REJECTED')), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_task_results_task_id_nf_tasks FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES nf_tasks (task_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_task_results_payload_hash_nf_objects FOREIGN KEY(payload_hash) REFERENCES nf_objects (hash)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_task_executions (
	attempt_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	task_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	worker_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_task_executions PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_execution_generation UNIQUE (task_id, generation), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_task_executions_task_id_nf_tasks FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES nf_tasks (task_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_call_attempts (
	attempt_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	task_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	budget_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	call_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	reserved_amount NUMERIC(20, 6) NOT NULL, 
	actual_amount NUMERIC(20, 6), 
	reserved_tokens BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	actual_tokens BIGINT, 
	provider_receipt TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_call_attempts PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_call_identity UNIQUE (task_id, generation, call_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_call_state CHECK (state IN ('PREPARED','SENT','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','UNKNOWN')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_call_amount CHECK (reserved_amount >= 0 AND (actual_amount IS NULL OR actual_amount >= 0)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_call_tokens CHECK (reserved_tokens >= 0 AND (actual_tokens IS NULL OR actual_tokens >= 0)), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_call_attempts_task_id_nf_tasks FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES nf_tasks (task_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_call_attempts_budget_id_nf_budgets FOREIGN KEY(budget_id) REFERENCES nf_budgets (budget_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_approvals (
	approval_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	proposal_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	grant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	applicability TEXT NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'true' NOT NULL, 
	epoch BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_approvals PRIMARY KEY (approval_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_approvals_proposal_id_nf_proposals FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES nf_proposals (proposal_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_approvals_grant_id_nf_grants FOREIGN KEY(grant_id) REFERENCES nf_grants (grant_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nf_certificates (
	certificate_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	proposal_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	artifact_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	validation_inputs JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_certificates PRIMARY KEY (certificate_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_certificates_proposal_id_nf_proposals FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES nf_proposals (proposal_id)
)

ALTER TABLE nf_branches ADD CONSTRAINT fk_branch_head_identity FOREIGN KEY(work_id, branch_id, head_revision_id) REFERENCES nf_revisions (work_id, branch_id, world_revision_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
ALTER TABLE nf_works ADD CONSTRAINT fk_work_canon_identity FOREIGN KEY(work_id, canon_branch_id) REFERENCES nf_branches (work_id, branch_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
CREATE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable authoritative record: %', TG_TABLE_NAME USING ERRCODE='23514'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_genesis FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_revisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_revision_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_commits FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_artifacts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_contexts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_proposals FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_certificates FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_receipts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_invalidations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_promotions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_task_inputs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_task_executions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_task_results FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_task_commands FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()

CREATE FUNCTION nf_scope_monotonic() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'scope tombstone required'; END IF; IF (NEW.work_id, NEW.branch_id, NEW.scope_key) IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.work_id, OLD.branch_id, OLD.scope_key) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'scope identity is immutable'; END IF; IF NEW.version <= OLD.version THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'scope version must increase'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql
CREATE TRIGGER nf_scope_monotonic_guard BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_scopes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_scope_monotonic()
